name: The Rising Sun, Falling Waves
source:
It is the turn of the century. The most unknown island on Earth has become the most surveillanced overnight- and somehow, a string of tragedies occur over and over, seemingly in plain sight. Full voice acting and a Tips system to help immerse you in the island of the Falling Waves.

[From [url=https://the-riley-fanfiction-club.itch.io/the-rising-sun-falling-waves]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在世纪之交。地球上最不为人知的一座岛屿，一夜之间成为了监控最严密的地方——然而不知为何，一连串的悲剧仍在众目睽睽之下周而复始地不断上演。本作配备全语音演出与词条系统，带你深度沉浸于这座“落波之岛”。

[引自[url=https://the-riley-fanfiction-club.itch.io/the-rising-sun-falling-waves]Itch.io[/url]]
